b:
In the light of early dusk
she rose like the moon

The calm of the deep sea
is defeated by her

But in me
she gathers
like a storm

And I forgot
this illusory life

Singing Tamil, as I lay
my head in her lap,
in the rain of her hair
her kiss on my lips
like an umbrella

It is a trick of the eye;
she fades away like a mirage
